items.exampleEn: Fitness fanatics fill the gym at six in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 一大早六點，健身狂就擠滿了健身房。

items.exampleEn: The traffic in the city center is appalling at rush hour.
items.exampleZh: 尖峰時段市中心的交通糟透了。

items.exampleEn: This apple tree is prolific; it gives hundreds of apples a year.
items.exampleZh: 這棵蘋果樹很會結果，一年能結好幾百顆蘋果。

items.exampleEn: It's ludicrous to pay that much for a T-shirt.
items.exampleZh: 花那麼多錢買一件 T-shirt 實在太荒謬了。

items.exampleEn: Years ago, experts scoffed at the idea of electric cars.
items.exampleZh: 多年前，專家們對電動車的構想嗤之以鼻。

items.exampleEn: Children often laugh spontaneously at small things.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們常常因為一些小事就自然地大笑。

items.exampleEn: The lion looked ferocious behind the thick glass.
items.exampleZh: 那隻獅子在厚玻璃後面看起來很兇猛。

items.exampleEn: The timid deer ran away when we came closer.
items.exampleZh: 我們一靠近，那頭膽小的鹿就跑走了。

items.sentenceEn: The prolific painter finished three new works this month.
items.sentenceZh: 那位多產的畫家這個月完成了三件新作品。

items.audioEn: She is a prolific writer who has published forty novels.
items.audioZh: 她是一位多產的作家，已經出版了四十本小說。
items.questionZh: 關於這位作家，下列何者正確？
options: She writes only one book a decade.
She is famous for her short poems.

items.sentenceEn: My brother is a football fanatic who never misses a match.
items.sentenceZh: 我哥是個足球迷，從不錯過任何一場比賽。

items.sentenceEn: The crowd spontaneously began to sing along.
items.sentenceZh: 群眾自發地跟著唱了起來。

items.stemEn: The idea of charging people for fresh air is simply ____.
items.stemZh: 向人收取新鮮空氣的費用，這個想法根本荒謬。

items.stemEn: Some customers ____ at the high prices and walked out of the shop.
items.stemZh: 有些顧客對高價嗤之以鼻，走出了店門。

items.passageEn: As a child, Tom was so timid that he hid behind his mother when visitors came. Nobody expected him to become a racing cyclist. When he first said he wanted to race, his friends scoffed and called the idea ludicrous. But Tom followed a methodical training plan and rode in all weather, even through ferocious winter storms. He became a cycling fanatic, and his results improved quickly. Today he regularly wins local races. He says the conditions on his first race day were appalling, with rain and mud everywhere, but he finished anyway.
items.passageZh: Tom 小時候非常膽小，家裡有客人來就躲到媽媽身後。沒有人想到他會成為單車競賽選手。他第一次說想參加比賽時，朋友們都嘲笑他，說這個想法很荒謬。但 Tom 照著有條理的訓練計畫，不論天氣如何都去騎車，就連猛烈的冬季暴風雨也不例外。他成了單車迷，成績也進步得很快。如今他經常在地方比賽中獲勝。他說，第一次比賽那天的狀況糟透了，到處都是雨水和泥巴，但他還是騎完了全程。

questions.questionZh: 朋友聽到 Tom 想比賽時有什麼反應？
第一次比賽那天的天氣怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 那隻貓看起來很兇，其實很膽小。
referenceEn: That cat looks fierce, but it is actually very timid.
The cat looks scary, but it is really quite timid.
rubricZh: timid 表示「膽小的」（例如 is very timid 等）
「看起來很兇」可寫，例如 looks fierce、looks scary 等

items.instructionZh: 用 fanatic 造一個句子，說說你或你認識的人對什麼事很狂熱。
referenceEn: I am a coffee fanatic and try a new cafe every week.
My father is a golf fanatic who plays every Sunday.
rubricZh: fanatic 當名詞表示「狂熱者、⋯迷」，常寫成「名詞＋fanatic」（例如 a coffee fanatic 等）
句子要說到你自己或你認識的人

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：lust 為 u10-l03 的生字，又在本課與 u10-l09 q14 當干擾項，名詞詞性與動詞空格不同、一眼可排除
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: lust、timid 換成 aimed、hinted（動詞，放得進 ____ at the high prices 但語意不通），保留 ferocious；不用 grumbled、marveled（可成立）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：a prolific winner of local races 搭配少見（prolific 多接 writer、scorer），宜作 he regularly wins local races
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Today he regularly wins local races."；prolific 改由聽打 q09 "The prolific painter finished three new works this month." 提供情境

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：翻譯「那隻狗看起來很兇」與 u10-l02 mcq 情境重複
執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 hinted 放進句中仍勉強說得通（customers hinted at the high prices）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: hinted 換成 sprouted（u03-l06；顧客不會發芽，語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：timid 表示「膽小的」（例如 is very timid 等）／「看起來很兇」可寫，例如 looks fierce、looks scary 等／「其實」可寫，例如 actually、really 等
